items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: Yeah, I didn't know that. No. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

ctx.x: He was only here, one, he had to leave the next day.

His mother, I believe, was sick or somebody in the family was sick, so he didn't get to see many people. He left right away. Very short trip. I saw him one day, just for a minute. Gabe, Gabe Pounders' sister is his mother. Who? Gabe Pounders, Tony Sabarbara. Tony Sabarbara. Yeah, I didn't know that. No. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
